name: xyz.urlgate/mcp
title: URLGate
description: Pay-to-open short links for humans and AI agents, charged in USDC over x402 v2.

tools.name: open_link
tools.description: Open a paid link. Without a payment signature you get the x402 v2 payment requirements; send them back signed to get the destination. Already paid, or your own link (signed in as that wallet: token, or a SIGN-IN-WITH-X header signed over this link's challenge)? You get the destination directly. Taken-down links return status 410 with a machine-readable reason. PAYMENT TAKES TWO SIGNATURES: (1) call without payment → isError result whose structuredContent is the x402 PaymentRequired; (2) sign one accepts[] entry (main leg, to the creator) AND the extensions["platform-fee"].accepts[] entry on the same network (0.3% fee leg, to URLGate), same wallet; (3) call again with both: params._meta["x402/payment"] + params._meta["x402/payment-fee"] (PaymentPayload objects) or the arguments paymentSignature + paymentSignatureFee (base64). Only the main leg → refused with fee_leg_missing before anything is charged. Balance must cover BOTH legs (else insufficient_funds, charged:false). If an earlier payment settled only one leg, the result has code partial_payment, partial { paid, owed } and accepts[] with ONLY the owed leg: sign that one and send it alone (fee owed: x402/payment-fee or paymentSignatureFee). Settlement comes back in result._meta["x402/payment-response"]. Test your client for free first with payment_compat_check. The preview testnet test link REQUIRES a wallet with Base Sepolia testnet + test USDC. If your wallet can't use testnet, follow the production path: run payment_compat_check on production (verify-only, no funds move) and, if you meet the two-signature requirements, proceed with the real paid tools.

paymentSignature.description: MAIN leg: base64 x402 v2 PaymentPayload for an accepts[] entry (same as the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header). Fallback for params._meta["x402/payment"], which wins when both are sent. Omit on the first call to get the payment requirements.

paymentSignatureFee.description: FEE leg (open_link only, REQUIRED when the requirements have extensions["platform-fee"]): base64 x402 v2 PaymentPayload for the extensions["platform-fee"].accepts[] entry on the same network, signed by the same wallet (same as PAYMENT-SIGNATURE-FEE). Fallback for params._meta["x402/payment-fee"]. Without it the call is refused with fee_leg_missing and nothing is charged. Sent ALONE when a partial payment owes only the platform fee (code partial_payment).

tools.name: payment_compat_check
tools.description: FREE, verify-only check that your x402 client can pay URLGate before you spend anything. Call without payment → isError result with a two-leg PaymentRequired (main accepts[] entry + extensions["platform-fee"] entry; tiny amounts, 30 s validBefore). Sign BOTH with the same wallet and call again with _meta["x402/payment"] + _meta["x402/payment-fee"] (or paymentSignature + paymentSignatureFee). Both legs are verified, NEVER settled; you get verdict ok | fee_leg_missing | main_leg_missing | wrong_network | bad_signature | amount_mismatch (or requirement_mismatch, payer_mismatch, expired, insufficient_funds, facilitator_unavailable). Signatures sent here can never pay for anything. The preview testnet test link REQUIRES a wallet with Base Sepolia testnet + test USDC. If your wallet can't use testnet, follow the production path: run payment_compat_check on production (verify-only, no funds move) and, if you meet the two-signature requirements, proceed with the real paid tools. Testnet path: 1. wallet on Base Sepolia with test USDC; 2. payment_compat_check on the preview deployment; 3. sign both legs, call again; 4. verdict ok = ready. Production path: 1. payment_compat_check on production (verify-only, no funds move); 2. sign both legs, call again; 3. verdict ok = proceed with the real paid tools.

Sent ALONE when a partial payment owes only the platform fee (code partial_payment).

tools.name: create_link
tools.description: Create a paid short link. Signed in (sign_in token / Bearer; SIGN-IN-WITH-X does not count) or with an agent key (token = ugk_…): FREE within your daily quota (10 a day, 100 on Premium; see get_started), the link and its earnings are your wallet's (an agent key's owner). Anonymous, over quota, or free creation paused: 0.01 USDC via x402: the call returns isError with the PaymentRequired and a code (anonymous, free_quota_exhausted, …) plus nextSteps in _meta["urlgate/payment-error"]; call again with the payment. Limits: 429 rate_limited, 409 duplicate_link, 403 domain_blocked. Payment is ONE signature (no platform-fee leg): sign an accepts[] entry and call again with params._meta["x402/payment"] (PaymentPayload) or paymentSignature (base64). Settlement comes back in result._meta["x402/payment-response"].

paymentSignature.description: MAIN leg: base64 x402 v2 PaymentPayload for an accepts[] entry (same as the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header). Fallback for params._meta["x402/payment"], which wins when both are sent. Omit on the first call to get the payment requirements.
